output.narrative: 分享故事时，孩子需要老师的提示，在老师的支持下参与故事分享。
During small-group time in December, the child confidently shares a story in Chinese, bringing a story to the group through spoken Chinese.
孩子的表达内容和分享对象在本学期有所拓展。学期初，在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字；到了三月，能向两位朋友讲述周末发生的事。六月在全班面前分享时，孩子开始讲述时需要老师提醒，并能向全班分享一段故事。从说出自己的名字，到向朋友讲述生活中的事情，再到面向全班分享故事，这些活动呈现了孩子参与表达的不同方式。

In March, the child told a short story to the class without a prompt. In the last two whole-class sharing sessions in June, the child needed prompting to begin and stopped after one sentence. These recent sessions show that beginning a whole-class contribution currently needs teacher support, with the child's spoken contribution in each of those sessions limited to one sentence.
这一年，孩子分享的内容与面向的听众有所拓展。年初，在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字。四月，孩子用短句向两位朋友讲述周末的事情，把自己的生活经历带入同伴间的交流。到了十二月，孩子能自信地在全班面前讲述一段故事。从说出自己的名字，到向朋友讲述经历，再到向全班分享故事，这些具体表现呈现了孩子表达内容的丰富，以及在全班分享时展现出的自信。

In shared block play with two classmates, the child's requests have moved from needing teacher modelling to using a suggested phrase after a reminder. In May, the child once asked to use a block without prompting and participated energetically, carrying blocks and suggesting ideas for a bridge. In the last three activities in June, the child contributed construction ideas and requested a turn after a teacher reminder; no unprompted request was recorded in those sessions. Reminders to wait until a peer finishes speaking remain part of supporting the child's participation in the shared building activity.
在提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字。面向全班讲述故事时，孩子在开始讲述时需要提示，并能参与全班的故事分享。这些表现呈现了孩子在支持下介绍自己和讲述故事的方式。
With picture prompts, the child shares a short story with classmates. In June's observation, pictures support the child's participation in telling a story to peers.

The child's contributions have expanded from one- or two-word answers to a teacher's direct questions in small-group picture discussions to sharing personal experiences with the class. In March, teacher questions supported short sentences about picture characters. In May, with a drawing and a reminder to begin, the child confidently described seeing ducks and using the park slide. In the two most recent class sharing sessions, a drawing and a reminder to begin supported accounts of three or four sentences. With a teacher prompt, the child also answered one follow-up question from a peer.

The child's spoken contributions have expanded across the semester's observations. In January, the child used single-word answers with prompting. By March, prompting supported short sentences describing a picture. In April, with picture prompts, the child told a short story to the class. These examples show the child using words in a wider range of spoken contributions, from answering to describing a picture and sharing a story with the class.

The child's number work has expanded from matching numerals 1 to 3 with counters in January to matching 1 to 6 in March, with teacher prompting in both activities. In May's small-group shop, the child selected a numeral from 1 to 6 and counted matching toy fruits, with a reminder to touch each once. In the last two small-group counting activities, that reminder supported counting groups of up to 8 objects. With teacher guidance, the child also checked which of two groups had more by placing the objects side by side.

output.narrative: With a teacher reminder to touch each counter, the child counts eight counters. This June observation captures the child's counting with that specific support.
这一年，孩子参与表达的内容和面向的听众有所拓展。年初，孩子在老师提示下说出自己的名字；四月，能向两位熟悉的朋友讲述一件事情。七月的小组活动中，孩子借助图片提示讲述故事，把表达延伸到故事分享。到了十二月底，孩子已经能在全班面前讲述一段故事，开始讲述时仍需要老师提醒。这些表现呈现了孩子从介绍自己、与熟悉的朋友交流，到参与小组及全班故事分享的变化。
在与同伴协商轮流使用积木时，孩子展现了一次减少提示的表现。二月，孩子在老师逐句提示下向同伴提出轮流使用积木的请求。到了六月的一次积木活动中，孩子没有老师提示便向同伴提出了轮流使用的请求。这一次具体的互动，记录了孩子主动用语言表达轮流使用需要的表现。

With a teacher reminder to touch each counter once, the child has counted larger groups over the year. January's observation records a group of 3 counters; in April, the child counted 6 with the same reminder. In July, this supported counting extended to a group of 9. By late December, the child counted a group of 12 counters, still with a teacher reminder to touch each one once. Across these observations, the range of quantities counted has expanded while the specific support for touching each counter remains part of the activity.
六月的观察呈现了孩子在不同分享情境中的表现。与两位熟悉的朋友交谈时，孩子能清楚地讲故事；在全班面前分享时，孩子需要老师逐句提示。老师的逐句支持是孩子参与全班分享时所需的帮助，而与熟悉朋友交谈时，孩子能够清楚表达故事内容。

The child's spoken sharing has expanded across the semester. Earlier in the semester, a teacher prompt supported saying the child's own name. In March, the child told two friends about a weekend activity, sharing a personal experience with peers. More recently, with a reminder to begin, the child shared a short story with the class. These observations trace a broader range of contributions, from naming to recounting an experience and telling a story to a larger audience, with a reminder still needed at the start of the June class sharing.

With teacher prompting, the child is matching a wider range of numerals to groups of objects. In February, this involved numerals 1 and 2. By June, the child matched numerals 1 to 6 to groups of objects, continuing to use teacher prompting as part of the activity.

十二月的小组活动中，孩子能自信地用中文分享故事，在小组的故事分享中展现了用中文表达的自信。
